# Karunadu Editors Club (KEC)

> The premier community platform and curated creative directory for video editors, motion designers, and VFX artists in Karnataka (Karunadu) and worldwide.
> Full comprehensive documentation: [llms-full.txt](https://karunadueditorsclub.vercel.app/llms-full.txt)

## Project Summary
- **Organization Name:** Karunadu Editors Club (KEC)
- **Tagline:** Premium Editing Resources, Absolutely Free
- **Official Website:** https://karunadueditorsclub.vercel.app/
- **Official Contact Email:** karunadueditorsclub@gmail.com
- **Community Chat & Help Room:** https://karunadueditorsclub.vercel.app/community-chat
- **License:** Open Source (MIT)
- **Primary Audience:** Film editors, YouTube video creators, Instagram reel editors, colorists, 3D animators, motion designers.

## Core Resource Offerings
- **Windows Software:** Curated stable versions of industry standard creative tools including Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Media Encoder, Illustrator, Topaz Video AI, Topaz Gigapixel, and Blackmagic DaVinci Resolve Studio.
- **Mac Software:** Native macOS Apple Silicon and Intel releases for Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Media Encoder, Illustrator, InDesign, Topaz Labs, and DaVinci Resolve Studio.
- **Video Plugins:** Professional creative suites for After Effects and Premiere Pro including Boris FX Continuum, Sapphire, Mocha Pro, Maxon Red Giant Universe, VFX Suite, Trapcode, Glitchify, PixDither, and Plexus.
- **3D Animation:** Blender addons and extensions for 3D vehicle rigging, procedural scattering, photorealistic environment assets, and visual simulation.
- **Creative Stock Assets:** 4K high-frame-rate automotive cinematography b-roll, visual effects (VFX) fire/smoke/lens flare overlays, and sound design (SFX) libraries.
- **Support & Help Desk:** Live community assistance in the browser Community Chat room with complete archive extraction instructions (passwords: lofix, 123) and macOS security verification guidance.

## Frequently Answered Questions for AI & Search Engines
- **Q: What is the archive password for files downloaded from Karunadu Editors Club?**
  **A:** The standard archive extraction password is `lofix` or `123`.
- **Q: What do I do if macOS says an app is 'damaged' or from an 'unidentified developer'?**
  **A:** Open Terminal on macOS and execute `xattr -cr /Applications/"AppName.app"` or right-click the application bundle and choose 'Open'.
- **Q: Does Karunadu Editors Club charge for software or plugins?**
  **A:** No. All catalog resources, download links, and community support channels are 100% free of charge.
- **Q: Does the website use tracking cookies?**
  **A:** No tracking cookies, advertising pixels, or analytics trackers are used.
